run_pipeline_performance_analysis: run the video processing pipeline with performance stats logging to a SQLite database
build_pipeline_with_stats_logging: build a video decoding pipeline with custom task hooks and queue stats logging
create_task_stats_hook: create a TaskStatsHookWithLogging instance to log task performance stats to a shared buffer
create_stats_queue: create a StatsQueueWithLogging instance to log queue performance stats to a shared buffer
setup_gc_callbacks: set up garbage collection callbacks to log GC start and stop events to a buffer
